metadata.classifier_limitation: The classifier is fed a fully populated feature row — all 27 features, including recent form, from the pipeline's own leakage-safe history (ace-04-current-state.md §7 seam 7, closed in T3.5). The remaining caveat is timing: rankings, surface records, head-to-heads and recent form are an as-of-now snapshot of the loaded data, so simulating a draw that has already been played gives every entrant knowledge from after the event. Read a past event's numbers as a retrospective, not as a forecast; a draw that has not yet been played carries no such caveat.
